summary: Rename the generic found locals to stage-accurate names in scan_artifacts

delivery.outcome: Clear the code2llm Shotgun Surgery smell for the variable 'found' in src/koru/scan_artifacts.py (planfile ticket PLF-041, reported at line 86) by replacing the generic local with a stage-accurate name in six of the seven functions that mutate it and inlining the seventh mutation into a pure selection: yaml_artifact (_load_yaml_mapping, the first existing YAML artifact probe hit whose first element is parsed), func_locations (_parse_high_cc_suggestions, the recorded file:line locations for the CC-reported function), validation_artifact (_scan_vallm_validation, the located VALLM validation report), report_artifact (_scan_structured_semcod_report, the located structured report shared by the pyqual/prefact/regix/redsl scanners), diagnose_artifact (_scan_pfix_report, the located Pfix diagnose report) and metrun_artifact (_scan_metrun_report, the located Metrun report). _find_analysis_file keeps no local: its single-use 'found if found is not None else (None, "")' inlines into the pure selection '_first_existing_artifact(project, _ANALYSIS_ARTIFACT_PATHS) or (None, "")' - the probe returns None or an always-truthy 2-tuple (path, candidate), so the or-evaluation is equivalent to the is-not-None check. The code2llm shotgun-surgery detector groups mutations by (file, variable) and fires at >= 5 scopes; the 'found' group drops from 7 scopes to 0 and the file mutation record count drops from 247 to 246 (the removed record is the deleted single-use binding in _find_analysis_file). Each new name lands at exactly 1 scope. No behavior change: same artifact probe order, same suggestions, same fallbacks, function signatures and the module __all__ untouched. No other file touched. No duplication.toon.yaml exists in this repository, so the duplication-report checklist has nothing to consult for the touched path.
nonGoals: No behavior, policy, message or interface change

No rename of other same-file mutation groups (path 12, rel 9, suggestions 7, payload 6, priority 6, text 6 scopes - each already a separate unreported dedupe key); this lane only clears the reported 'found' group of the cited dedupe key

No new shared helper; the six surviving renames bind different artifact families and lookup shapes (a YAML payload source, a per-function location list, four distinct report probes) and forcing an abstraction would couple independent scanners
No rename of the candidates/rel_paths parameters or _first_existing_artifact itself (read-only parameters and the shared probe are not counted as mutations by the detector)

architecture.decision: Stage-accurate local naming plus one pure selection inside one module. Every function that mutated the generic name 'found' names exactly the scanner stage whose artifact probe or lookup it binds: the YAML mapping loader names its artifact probe hit (yaml_artifact), the high-CC parser names the recorded locations of the reported function (func_locations), and the four report scanners name the report family they probe (validation_artifact, report_artifact, diagnose_artifact, metrun_artifact). The analysis-file finder inlines its single-use binding into the pure selection '_first_existing_artifact(...) or (None, "")'. The generic name 'found' disappears from the file's mutation set entirely. Verified with the installed code2llm DFGExtractor mutation grouping on the file's AST (standalone extract, since ProjectAnalyzer.analyze on copies/worktrees silently yields empty scopes): baseline reports a 'found' mutation group of exactly 7 scopes - _find_analysis_file, _load_yaml_mapping, _parse_high_cc_suggestions, _scan_vallm_validation, _scan_structured_semcod_report, _scan_pfix_report, _scan_metrun_report - matching the ticket's 'spans 7 functions'; after the change the 'found' group is empty, the file mutation record count drops from 247 to 246, each renamed local lands at exactly 1 scope, and no other group newly reaches the threshold (pre-existing >= 5 groups unchanged: path 12, rel 9, suggestions 7, payload 6, priority 6, text 6).
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; the locals are named found again and the smell report returns.

validation.evidence: Deterministic ground truth with the installed code2llm extractor on the file AST. Baseline content reports a 'found' mutation group of 7 scopes (_find_analysis_file, _load_yaml_mapping, _parse_high_cc_suggestions, _scan_vallm_validation, _scan_structured_semcod_report, _scan_pfix_report, _scan_metrun_report) - exactly matching the ticket's reported 'spans 7 functions' - and 247 total mutation records; renamed content reports a 'found' group of 0 scopes and 246 records (the removed record is the inlined single-use _find_analysis_file binding); each renamed local lands at exactly 1 scope (yaml_artifact, func_locations, validation_artifact, report_artifact, diagnose_artifact, metrun_artifact); no other variable group newly reaches the >= 5 threshold (pre-existing groups unchanged: path 12, rel 9, suggestions 7, payload 6, priority 6, text 6).

The three scan suites covering every touched scanner (artifact probing, high-CC location lookup, vallm/pfix/metrun/structured-report scans, the koru.scan facade) show no new failures versus the same suites on the accepted base (known environmental main-baseline reds in tests/test_scan.py are unchanged and unrelated to this file); ruff reports zero errors on the touched file.
GOV-PASS 0 errors 0 warnings from the ticket worktree with the changed files declared.
